author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Every repo should have these markdown files
AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md - instructions for the AI
README.md - easy to read for humans, who don't need to know the details
CONTRIBUTING.md - instructions for the developer
session_history/<date>-<slug>.md - extract your conversation with AI into a prompt to reproduce your commit
and yes - humans are banned from writing code by hand, only AI is allowed to edit anything
